restoration_note: Teaching describes the Living Spirit's three-fold accommodation: he clothes himself in wind/fire/water (perception, will, natural truth) to subject the works of darkness above and below, then strips the garments off so the captive material may be purified and conveyed upward through the Zone to the Upper Place. Editor's restorations are largely confirmed by formula (ⲙⲛⲛⲥⲱⲥ, ⲁⲃⲁⲗ, ⲍⲃⲥⲱ keyword, ⲡⲓⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ, ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲧⲛⲉ/ⲛⲁⲡⲧⲛⲉ pair). I corrected {16} from ⲛⲁⲓ to ⲇⲓ (standard ⲇⲓⲕⲁⲓⲟⲥ), accepted the partial trace ⲡⲧⲏⲩ at {14}, and proposed ⲍⲃⲥⲱ at {9} since 'subjected them in the [garments]' fits both the 4-char count and the teaching's central instrument. Twelve gaps remain too damaged: the {0}/{1} idiom 'ⲭⲛ̄ X-ⲛⲉ ⲛⲟⲩ-Y', the section-opening verbs at {2}/{4}/{13}/{21}, the verb at {12} ('[verb]-forth the works' could be ⲁϥⲃⲁϣ/ⲁϥⲥⲁⲣ but 4-char count is uncertain), and the chain {24}/{25}/{26}/{28} of upward-motion phrases lacking syntactic anchor.
